description:
A mutation permitted by an explicit override of the linked-checkout write stance becomes
durable together with its audit record through the same materialization plan; if the
application fails, neither lands.

## Background

Events become durable only when mutation intents are finalized into one materialization plan
and applied through the recovering transaction kernel; an event variant on its own publishes
nothing. The carrier spans the whole path through the converged construction boundary: the
dispatch site that decides an override permitted the invocation sets the fact once into the
factory's dispatch-scoped annotation slot; the factory stamps it into the production context
wherever one is constructed; the context carries it to the finalizer, whose event pass
composes the audit append; and because the second finalizer path used for
initialization-style audit appends shares that same event-pass helper, one edit covers both
paths, so no materialization path can emit its events while omitting the record.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A mutation permitted by an explicit override materializes its audit record in the same finalized plan as the mutation, and both become durable in one application.
- [hard] REQ-02: An injected persistence failure during that application leaves neither the mutation nor the audit record behind after recovery.
- [hard] REQ-03: On success, the audit record is readable from the event log alongside the mutation's own events, in canonical order.
- [hard] REQ-04: An invocation with no override in effect emits no audit record, so a repository that declares neither a stance nor an override sees no new events.
- [hard] REQ-05: The dispatch-set override fact reaches both finalizer paths that compose audit appends, with coverage that fails if a materialization path omits the record.

## Notes

The finalizer documents that a no-transition plan carries an empty delta and emits no bytes.
The audit record accompanies real events only: an override in effect during a no-op mutation
produces no record, preserving that documented property.
title: Publish the override audit record with the mutation it permits
